_comment: VSCode MCP Configuration for SAP BTP OData Server
_important: Redirect URI must be configured in xs-security.json
Update xs-security.json and redeploy XSUAA service before testing

authentication._redirectUri_note: MUST use localhost (NOT 127.0.0.1) and MUST be configured in xs-security.json

metadata.name: SAP OData MCP Server
metadata.description: Access SAP OData services via natural language on SAP BTP

xsuaa_setup_instructions.step_1: Update xs-security.json to include your VSCode redirect URI
xsuaa_setup_instructions.step_3: Redeploy XSUAA service: cf update-service YOUR_XSUAA_SERVICE -c xs-security.json
xsuaa_setup_instructions.step_4: Get client credentials from XSUAA service binding
xsuaa_setup_instructions.step_5: Replace YOUR_PORT with the actual port VSCode MCP uses (e.g., 3000 or 6274)
important_notes: Exact redirect URI must match xs-security.json configuration
XSUAA supports wildcards like 'http://localhost:6274/**' for dynamic ports
